node.statement: By nodes 1.2 and 1.3, for every target element Y and Z=(T_n)^(-1)Y one has ||Y||=||T_n(Z)|| >= (1-C_diag*e)||Z||. Node 1.1 gives x:=C_diag*e in [0,1/2], so 1/(1-x)=1+x/(1-x) <= 1+2x. Consequently ||(T_n)^(-1)Y|| <= (1-C_diag*e)^(-1)||Y|| <= (1+2*C_diag*e)||Y|| = (1+C_inv*e)||Y||. Since the datum and n were arbitrary, every amplification is bijective with the asserted inverse bound, proving node 1.
